text:
Ravi: quick ping — spun up ferris-7b-v2 on staging, can someone run a very small correctness healthcheck (3 short prompts) + a quant check? seeing a repeated token in one prompt :eyes:
Sam: on it — which endpoint should I hit, staging or dedicated?
Ravi: staging. use the /v1/models/ferris-7b-v2/outputs route. quick curl: ```curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"ferris-7b-v2","prompt":"Translate to French: Hello world","max_tokens":30}'```
Ana: running three tiny probes now (translation, list, short Q&A). will compare fp16 vs int8 quant outputs and paste results.
Ana: fp16 -> Translate: "Bonjour le monde" (good)
Ana: fp16 -> List probe input: "List items: a, b, c" -> output: "a, b, c" (good)
Ana: fp16 -> Q&A: "Why is the sky blue?" -> sensible answer.
Ana: int8 -> Translate: "Bonjour le monde" (good)
Ana: int8 -> List probe -> output: "a, b, c, c" (duplicate last token) — repros consistently on this prompt :thinking_face:
Julie: if it's a token split/merge issue, try forcing tokenizer=vocab-v2 or use byte-level tokenization to see where boundary lands.
Sam: got perf quick-run from CI: `ci-bot` results: p50=120ms p95=320ms for int8 on a2-gpu, throughput looks fine. no OOMs.
ci-bot: Perf test finished for ferris-7b-v2 (rev r12): p50=120ms; p95=320ms; mem_peak=10.2GB.
DeployBot: Deployed ferris-7b-v2 to staging (rev r12) — triggered by @Ravi :rocket:
Sam: tried rerun with temp=0.0 and deterministic sampling — hallucination in Q&A went away, but the duplicate token in the list probe persists. command used: `--temp 0.0 --top_k 40`.
Ana: minimal repro attached: input `List items: a, b, c` -> output `a, b, c, c` (int8 only). also saw a case where tokenization adds a leading space sometimes (" c" vs "c").
Ravi: thanks — I'll kick off a small trace to capture token boundaries + kv-cache transitions. sample trace command: `REDWOOD_TRACE=1 ./bin/trace-infer --model ferris-7b-v2 --input "List items: a, b, c" --quant int8`
Julie: quick checklist item to add to onboarding notes: - verify tokenizer compatibility (vocab versions) - deterministic probe (temp=0) - kv-cache warmup and boundary testing - quantization mismatch checks (fp16 vs int8) - small prompt set for regen/dedup tests
Sam: I'll re-run with tokenizer=vocab-v2 and also try symmetric per-channel re-quantization and report back. :thumbsup:
Ana: if re-quant fixes it, we mark as quant calibration bug; if not, likely runtime token concatenation issue. will log a short repro in GH with exact curl + outputs.
Ravi: perfect — tag me in the GH issue. if we can't fix quickly let's gate the model for Dedicated rollouts until resolved. tagging @Ana @Sam for followups. :pray:
